The '''Darepp system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Southern Core]] portion<ref name="TEA" /> of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Darepp]].<ref name="CSWE-Darepp">{{CSWECite|I|166|Darepp}}</ref> The Darepp system was located near the [[Foless Crossroads/Legends|Foless Crossroads]].<ref name="CSWE-Foless Crossroads">{{CSWECite|I|284|Foless Crossroads}}</ref>
